rows.label: tlk43200144_03_msg0001
rows.name:
Do you know where Queen Lagert's
palace is?

rows.label: tlk43200144_03_msg0002
rows.name:
It is above Sevind Palace Plaza.
Ordinary people cannot go inside.

rows.label: tlk43200144_03_msg0003
rows.name:
I've been watching the windows, hoping
Queen Lagert-sama might show her face,
but I haven't seen her at all.

rows.label: tlk43200144_03_msg0004
rows.name: Actually, I've not seen anyone at all!

rows.label: tlk43200144_03_msg0005
rows.name:
The six nobles of Invidia are all
very cautious, aren't they?
